content: Aɓwana mala Ɓakuli

Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun nǝ̀ kánǝ wun aɓa nzali mǝno wun ndo wun nǝ̀ ká é ɓǝ̀ duk ma'wun ngga. Yahweh nǝ̀ pǝr aɓwapǝndǝa mala anzali pas ɓǝà nyingga wun ban; nǝ̀ pǝr amǝ'Hitti, andǝ amǝ'Girgash, andǝ amǝ'Amor, andǝ amǝ'Kan'ana, andǝ amǝ'Periz, andǝ amǝ'Hivi, andǝ amǝ'Jebus; anzali tongno-nong-ɓari mǝnana à làkkì à kútì wun, sǝ à kútì wun nǝ rǝcandǝa ka.
Sǝ lang Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun pànà aɓwana man a ɓabù wun, sǝ wu linamurǝm amúrià ka, wu tària aban Yahweh ace twaltea kat-kat.
Wu kǝa kùrcau wunǝia, ko wun nǝ̀ lǝmdǝia wia mǝsǝswatǝr ɗàng.
Wu kǝa kútí a alban wunǝia ɗàng. Wu kǝa pà amuna-mamǝna ma'wun ɓǝà al amuna-burana malea ɗàng, sǝ wu kǝa eare ɓǝ̀ amuna-burana ma'wun al atà amuna-mamǝna malea ɗàng,
acemǝnana à nǝ̀ pwan ɓabum amuna ma'wun arǝ kpata Yahweh ace peri aban aɓea aɓakuli. Sǝ ɓǝ̀ pa anggo ka, bumlulla mala Yahweh nǝ̀ earke amur wun, nǝ̀ kiɗiki wun akaurǝa.
Acemani ka, mǝnia nda gìr mǝnana wun nǝ̀ pang nǝia ka: Wu bǝbbǝriki agyangŋan malea, wu arki akúnamúrú malea, wu tsauwiki atondong mala Ashera,
sǝ wu pisǝ aɓǝ̀nzál malea a bǝsa.

Wu pàk mǝnia yì gìr ka acemǝnana wu nda ka aɓwana amǝfele aban Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun. Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun ngga tàr wun aɓalǝ aɓwapǝndǝa mǝnana kat a ɓanza ka ɓǝ̀ wu duk girkuma male mǝnana earkiyi acea raka.
Tǝr tàrban mala amǝ Isǝrayila
Earban mana Yahweh earmúr wun sǝ tàr wun ngga, pà acemǝnana wu làkkì wu kútì acili aɓwapǝndǝa ka ɗàng; yàle wun nda kǝ nzali mǝnana làkkì ma'wun gatti acili anzali kat ka.

Sǝama Yahweh ka tàr wun acemǝnana earce wun; sǝ ace domǝsǝcau male arǝ pacau mǝnana pà aban aká wun nǝ kángìr ka, pusǝ wun nǝ rǝcandǝa mǝgule, akmúr wun a ɓala guro, a ɓabù rǝcandǝa mala Firona murǝm Masar.

Acemani ka, wu sǝlǝa ama Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun ngga nda Ɓakuli. Yì ka nda Ɓakuli mǝ'domǝsǝcaunì mǝnana kǝ kpata kùrcau male, sǝ kǝ lǝmdǝ earcearǝu male mǝnana kǝ gǝshi raka aban aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ earce, sǝ à kǝ bwal anzongcau male ka, aban ká arǝ anza malea á-pas.
Sǝama aɓwana mǝnana à ɓinǝmǝsǝì ka, nǝ̀ mbwea akǝ mǝsǝia nǝ́ twaltea; amǝ ɓinǝmǝsǝì ka, pà nǝ̀ dǝndi arǝ mbwea akǝ mǝsǝia nǝ gìr mǝnana karǝ arǝia ka ɗàng.
Acemani ka, wu tsǝkir wun arǝ kpata anzongcau, andǝ anê, andǝ angguracau mǝnana ǝn nggǝ pa wun yalung ngga.
Tsǝkbu mǝnana kǝ gyata okiru ka

Ɓǝ̀ wu kwakikir wun arǝ amǝnia yì anggurcau sǝ wu kpatea nǝ mǝsǝcau ka, Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun nǝ̀ lidǝmba nǝ bwal kùrcau mala earcearǝu male mǝnana kǝ gǝshi raka aban wun, kǝla mǝnana kánbì aká wun ngga.

Yì ka nǝ̀ earce wun, nǝ̀ tsǝka wun bù, sǝ nǝ̀ hatǝki wun. Ɗǝm ngga nǝ̀ tsǝka wun bù mala ɓǝl amuna pas, sǝ mala kum girlina kpǝm a nzali ma'wun; wun nǝ̀ kum mǝsǝsa, andǝ mùr-anap, andǝ mùrú olif arǝ aɓaban ma'wun; amuna-ndá andǝ amuna-mbùl arǝ adomwan ma'wun nǝ̀ lakkì aɓa nzali mǝnana kánbì aká wun nǝ̀ pà wun ngga.
Kǝ nzali mala aɓwapǝndǝa pa kàm a ɓanza nǝ̀ kum ulang tsǝkbu ma'wun ɗàng. Kǝ ɓwa pa atà wun, ko ɓwabura ko ɓwama, ko kǝ girkusǝu ma'wun nǝ̀ duk nkombi ɗang.
Yahweh nǝ̀ yál wun arǝ akwánó kat, sǝ pà nǝ̀ nying kǝ kwánó-ɓikea mala Masar, mǝnana wu súrǝ̀ia ka ɓǝ̀ yiu amúr wun ɗàng; a kún mani ka, nǝ̀ sulǝia amúr aɓwana mǝnana kat à kǝ ɓinǝmǝsǝ wun ngga.
Wu kiɗiki anzali andǝ aɓakuli malea

Wu twalta aɓwapǝndǝa mala anzali mǝnana kat Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun pàna wunia a ɓabù wun ngga. Wu kǝa sǝn mǝsǝswatǝr malea ɗàng. Wu kǝa kpata acau mala aɓakuli malea ɗàng, acemǝnana mǝno ka nǝ̀ dupa wun gbǝ́lî.
Wu kǝa ne a ɓabum wun ama, <<Aɓwapǝndǝa man kútì sǝm, lang sǝ sǝm nǝ̀ gandǝ pǝria, sǝm nǝ̀ ak nzali arǝia?>>
Wu kǝa ɓanggia wia ɗàng. Wu ɗenyinǝ gir mǝnana Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun pakkî Firona andǝ aɓwana mala nzali Masar kat ka.

Mǝsǝ wun sǝnǝna anggea gìr'mur'mwana, yì agir-lǝmdǝa, andǝ agir-ndǝlǝki, mǝnana Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun peǎ nǝ rǝcandǝa male andǝ mazo mala nggwarbui sǝ pusǝ wun a nzali Masar ka. Anggo sǝ Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun nǝ̀ pàkkî aɓwapǝndǝa mǝnana kat wu kǝ ɓanggia wia ka.
Ɗǝm ngga, acilia mǝnana à ueo sǝ à ɓangŋa à sǝmbǝrǝki ka, Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun nǝ̀ tasǝia wia amǝ'ta-nta aɓalǝia ɓǝà tàkia, ɓǝà twaltea kat.
Acemani ka, múr wun ɓǝkǝa kàr wún arǝ aɓwana mǝnia ka ɗàng, acemǝnana Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun, yì Ɓakuli mǝgule, mǝpandali ka, nda atà wun.
Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun nǝ̀ nggǝ pǝr aɓwapǝndǝa mala anzali mǝnia ka bǝti-bǝti. Pà nǝ̀ eara wun ɓǝ̀ wu twaltea atārǝia kat ɗàng; ɓǝ̀ eara wun ngga, anyam-bondo nǝ̀ ɓiki lákkià wun.
Yahweh nǝ̀ tasǝ aɓiwun amǝbura a ɓabù wun; nǝ̀ túriá aɓa zùrǝki mǝgule, she ɓǝà kiɗikina ka.
Nǝ̀ tasǝ amurǝma malea a ɓabù wun. Lullǝia pà nǝ̀ nyare nǝ̀ pà a ɗenyicau mala aɓwana a ɓanza ɗǝm ɗàng. Kǝ ɓwa pà kàm nǝ̀ gandǝ came a kún wun ɗàng; wun nǝ̀ kiɗikia kat.

Wu pisǝ aɓǝ̀nzál mala aɓakuli malea mana à shària ka, a bǝsa. Wu kǝa sham bolo-azǝrfa ko bolo-njengǝlan mǝnana à gìrna rǝ aɓǝ̀nzál mala aɓakuli malea nǝi ka ɗàng, sǝ kǝɓwa atà wun ɓǝ̀ kǝa earce ama nǝ̀ twali ɓǝ̀ pǝlǝ male ɗàng. Ɓǝ̀ wu pàk ka, nǝ̀ nggá pǝlǝà wun gbǝ́lî, acemǝnana bwal gìr mala aɓea aɓakuli ka, gìr na mǝnana Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'wun ɓinǝce ka.
Wu kǝa yinǝ ɓekǝ gìr'ɓeami arǝ aɓala ma'wun ɗàng, ɓǝ̀ ana raka wun nǝ̀ duk gìr mǝnana à tàrni ace kiɗike ka, kǝla gìrnî. Wu ɓinǝkia sǝ wu ginǝkicea, acemǝnana agir na mǝnana à tàrnia ace kiɗikia ka.

footnotes.text: Sǝni gbal aɓa: Nggur 20:17; Pur 22:20; Pǝris 27:29; Ɓal 21:2-3
atondong mala Ashera: anggun mǝsake mǝnana à shària ace pángŋǝ̀nà-túró nǝia lang à nǝ̀ peri aban Ashera, yì mā-ɓakuli malea ka.
